verdict.rationale: A built-in AI agent is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, but nothing in the evidence shows Ghostty ships an agent that plans and runs commands with user approval. AppleScript and keybind actions are scripting surfaces, not an AI agent, so they earn no credit. One user even describes leaving Ghostty for Warp because it is 'barebones'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate terminal tasks to a built-in AI agent that plans and executes commands with my approval
